templates.name: Device replacement
templates.workNotes: Hardware defect confirmed on {{configuration_item|the device}}. Replacement device arranged for {{user_name}}.
templates.commentEn: We have confirmed a hardware defect and arranged a replacement device for you.
templates.commentNl: We hebben een hardwaredefect vastgesteld en een vervangend apparaat voor u geregeld.

templates.name: Hardware diagnostics
templates.workNotes: Ran hardware diagnostics on {{configuration_item|the device}} with {{user_name}} via {{contact_method}}.
templates.commentEn: We have run diagnostics on your device to determine the cause of the issue.
templates.commentNl: We hebben een diagnose op uw apparaat uitgevoerd om de oorzaak van het probleem te bepalen.

templates.name: Docking station / monitor
templates.workNotes: Checked docking station, cabling and display settings for {{user_name}}. Firmware/driver status verified.
templates.commentEn: We have checked your docking station and monitor setup.
templates.commentNl: We hebben uw dockingstation en monitoropstelling gecontroleerd.

templates.name: Software installation
templates.workNotes: Software requested by {{user_name}} installed/pushed via the software deployment tool on {{configuration_item|the device}}.
templates.commentEn: The requested software has been installed on your device. Please restart your device if it does not appear.
templates.commentNl: De aangevraagde software is op uw apparaat geïnstalleerd. Start uw apparaat opnieuw op als het niet zichtbaar is.

templates.name: Outlook / Office issue
templates.workNotes: Investigated Outlook/Office issue with {{user_name}}. Profile, add-ins and cached mode checked.
templates.commentEn: We have investigated the issue with Outlook/Office together with you.
templates.commentNl: We hebben samen met u het probleem met Outlook/Office onderzocht.

templates.name: Account unlocked / password reset
templates.workNotes: Identity of {{user_name}} verified according to procedure. Account unlocked / password reset initiated.
templates.commentEn: Your account has been unlocked. You can now sign in again.
templates.commentNl: Uw account is ontgrendeld. U kunt nu weer inloggen.

templates.name: VPN connectivity
templates.workNotes: Troubleshot VPN connectivity with {{user_name}}: client version, certificate and network connection checked.
templates.commentEn: We have checked your VPN connection together with you.
templates.commentNl: We hebben samen met u uw VPN-verbinding gecontroleerd.

templates.name: Wi-Fi / network
templates.workNotes: Checked Wi-Fi/network connectivity for {{configuration_item|the device}}: adapter, drivers, IP configuration and profile.
templates.commentEn: We have checked your network/Wi-Fi connection.

templates.name: Appointment scheduled
templates.workNotes: Appointment scheduled with {{user_name}} on {{followup_date}} at {{followup_time}} via {{contact_method}}.
templates.commentEn: As agreed, we have scheduled an appointment on {{followup_date}} at {{followup_time}}.
templates.commentNl: Zoals afgesproken hebben we een afspraak ingepland op {{followup_date}} om {{followup_time}}.

templates.name: Appointment – user not available
templates.workNotes: Appointment attempt: {{user_name}} not available at the agreed time. New attempt planned.
templates.commentEn: Unfortunately we could not reach you at the agreed time. We will try again.
templates.commentNl: Helaas konden we u op het afgesproken tijdstip niet bereiken. We proberen het opnieuw.

templates.name: Pending – awaiting user
templates.workNotes: Ticket set to pending: awaiting response from {{user_name}}.
templates.commentEn: We are waiting for your response so we can continue with your request.
templates.commentNl: We wachten op uw reactie zodat we verder kunnen met uw melding.

templates.name: Pending – awaiting supplier
templates.workNotes: Case logged with supplier; awaiting supplier response.
templates.commentEn: We are waiting for feedback from our supplier and will update you as soon as we hear back.
templates.commentNl: We wachten op terugkoppeling van onze leverancier en houden u op de hoogte.

templates.name: Escalation to 2nd line
templates.workNotes: Escalated to {{assignment_group|2nd line}} after first-line troubleshooting. All findings documented above.
templates.commentEn: Your ticket has been forwarded to a specialised team who will contact you.
templates.commentNl: Uw melding is doorgezet naar een gespecialiseerd team dat contact met u opneemt.

templates.name: Possible major incident
templates.workNotes: Multiple users affected. Service desk lead / major incident manager informed. Linking related tickets.
templates.commentEn: We are aware of a wider disruption and are working on it with priority.
templates.commentNl: We zijn op de hoogte van een bredere verstoring en werken hier met prioriteit aan.

templates.name: Resolved – confirmed by user
templates.workNotes: Issue resolved. {{user_name}} confirmed via {{contact_method}} that everything works as expected.
templates.commentEn: Your issue has been resolved, as you confirmed. If the issue returns, simply reply to this ticket.
templates.commentNl: Uw probleem is opgelost, zoals u heeft bevestigd. Mocht het probleem terugkomen, reageer dan op deze melding.

templates.name: Resolved – no response
templates.workNotes: No response from {{user_name}} after multiple contact attempts. Ticket resolved according to procedure.
templates.commentEn: We have not been able to reach you after several attempts and will resolve this ticket. Reply to reopen it if needed.
templates.commentNl: We hebben u na meerdere pogingen niet kunnen bereiken en lossen deze melding op. Reageer om de melding te heropenen indien nodig.
